map.低温有风时由气温与风速算体感风寒。: Compute the apparent wind chill from air temperature and wind speed at low temperature with wind.

At the same −10°C, wind speed from 5 to 20 km/h lowers the apparent temperature from about −14°C to −17.8°C; the stronger the wind the faster the heat loss.
map.适用温度？: Which temperature does it apply to?
map.通常用于气温≤10°C 且风速>4.8 km/h，高温无风寒效应，反而用炎热指数: Usually for air temperature ≤10°C and wind speed >4.8 km/h; at high temperature there is no wind chill effect, and the heat index is used instead.
map.体感低于气温会冻伤？: Does an apparent temperature below the air temperature cause frostbite?
map.体感越低皮肤降温越快，−18°C 以下暴露 30min 可冻伤，按风寒分级做户外: The lower the apparent temperature the faster the skin cools; exposure below −18°C for 30 min can cause frostbite, so limit outdoor duration by the wind chill grade.
